sloka: ततो निष्पततो युद्धे दशग्रीवस्य रक्षसः।रणे निधनशंसीनि रूपाण्येतानि जज्ञिरे ।। ६.९६.३८ ।।
transliteration: tato niṣpatato yuddhe daśagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ।raṇe nidhanaśaṁsīni rūpāṇyetāni jajñire ।। 6.96.38 ।।

translations.english: Impelled by the time spirit, Ravana set forth without thinking of the terrific portents that had appeared in delusion for his destruction.
